app.name: Forkfix
app.description: Shows what the security-fix pipeline is doing to each issue, what needs a human, and what it cost.

demo.definition: DEMO mode: GitHub and Devin are simulated and only the seeded issues are shown. Nothing here is real activity.

overview.title: Overview
overview.heading: Security fixes for {repo}
overview.automation_rate_definition: Share of finished issues the pipeline closed out on its own: (PRs opened + not reachable) ÷ (PRs opened + not reachable + needs a human). Issues still in progress, with errors or cancelled are left out.
overview.median_time_to_pr_definition: Median time from when an issue was first seen to when its fix PR was opened, across issues with a PR.
overview.acu_definition: Each Devin session reserves its ACU cap against the ceiling before it starts. Committed is the sum of those reservations, not metered use.
overview.acu_left: {remaining} left before new sessions wait for budget
overview.acu_full: Ceiling reached: new sessions wait until you raise it or reservations are released
overview.error_hint: The pipeline stopped with an error. Check the history, then remove and re-add the trigger label to retry.
overview.attention_empty: Nothing needs a human right now.
overview.empty_body: Add the {label} label to a Dependabot issue in {repo}, then run a sweep to pick it up.

sync.heading: Upstream sync
sync.off: Upstream sync is off. Set UPSTREAM_SYNC_ENABLED to turn it on.
sync.never: Upstream sync is on but hasn't run yet.

reason.major_bump: Major version bump {old} → {new}; a person should review it.
reason.reachable: Reachable with medium or high confidence: {ids}.
reason.none_qualifying: No CVE is reachable with medium or high confidence.
reason.bump_unknown: Couldn't confirm the bump isn't a major version.
reason.no_triage: Triage didn't return a usable result.
reason.no_cve_ids: The issue lists no CVE IDs, so triage can't be checked.
reason.triage_opened_pr: The triage session opened a PR, which it must not do.
reason.create_unknown: It's unclear whether the session started; its ACU reservation is kept until someone checks.
reason.fix_no_pr: The fix session finished without opening a PR.
reason.errored: The {stage} session ended with an error.
reason.timed_out: The {stage} session didn't finish within {limit} s.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.heading: Pipeline
pipeline.subheading: One row per issue: where it is, what triage found, and why it was routed that way.

issue.title: Issue #{number}
issue.missing_body: Forkfix hasn't seen this issue. Check the number, or add the trigger label on GitHub and run a sweep.
issue.default_off: not reachable in a default install
issue.evidence_pending: Evidence appears here when triage finishes.
issue.evidence_missing: Triage didn't return evidence for this issue. Open the triage session to see what happened.
issue.history_empty: No events recorded for this issue yet.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.heading: Devin sessions
sessions.subheading: Every session the pipeline started, newest first, with its ACU cap and what the plan reported.
sessions.empty_body: Sessions start after the sweep picks up a labeled issue. Run a sweep to start one.

cost.title: Cost
cost.heading: Cost
cost.subheading: ACUs reserved against the ceiling, in total and per issue.
cost.committed_question: How close is the pipeline to its ACU ceiling?
cost.chart_desc: {count} active reservations total {committed} ACUs against a ceiling of {ceiling} ACUs.
cost.short_history: Reservations so far: {count}, all within {span}. That's too close together for a time chart, so each one is shown in order.
cost.no_reservations: No ACUs reserved yet. Reservations appear when a session starts.
cost.cancelled_note: Cancelled reservations not shown: {count}. The ledger doesn't record when they were released.
cost.metered_total: Devin reported {value} ACUs consumed across all sessions.
cost.metered_none: {count} finished sessions report 0 metered ACUs. Treat committed ACUs above as the most it can have cost.

event.fix_no_pr: The fix session finished without a PR.
event.queued_budget: Waiting for budget: the {stage} cap of {cap} ACUs doesn't fit under the ceiling.
event.queued_budget_commented: Posted a budget-wait comment on the issue ({committed} of {ceiling} ACUs committed).
event.queued_budget_comment_failed: Couldn't post the budget-wait comment ({committed} of {ceiling} ACUs committed).
event.triage_create_ambiguous: Unclear whether the triage session started; checking before retrying.
event.fix_create_ambiguous: Unclear whether the fix session started; checking before retrying.
event.devin_poll_failed: Couldn't reach Devin to check the session. Retrying.
event.pipeline_error: The pipeline stopped with an error.
event.readopted_after_restart: Picked up session {session} again after a restart.
event.create_ambiguous_after_restart: After a restart, it was unclear whether a session had started.
event.triage_rejected: Triage was rejected because it opened a PR.
event.webhook_accepted: Label added on GitHub; the webhook was accepted.

js.paused: Updates paused while this tab is hidden
js.offline: Can't reach the server. Showing data from {time}; retrying every {seconds} s.
js.sweep_forbidden: The sweep only runs from an allowed local address. Run it from the machine that hosts Forkfix.
js.sweep_failed: The sweep couldn't reach GitHub. Try again in a minute.
js.sweep_offline: Can't reach the server. Check that Forkfix is running, then try again.
js.sweep_done_other: Sweep finished: {count} new issues ({found} labeled in total).
